facts.label: Wands, staves and relics
facts.value: Enchanters can now craft wands, staves and relics. Some crafts are Bind on Pickup for the enchanter, such as the Brilliant Wand.

facts.label: Camp objects
facts.value: Enchanted Lute at skill 20, Arcane Salvager at 140 and Arcane Forge at 300. Icy Veins puts the Arcane Salvager blueprint on Rath'mael in the Ruins of Lordaeron; another guide disagrees.

facts.label: Skill ranks
facts.value: Apprentice up to 75, Journeyman up to 150 (skill 50, level 10), Expert up to 225 (skill 125, level 20) and Artisan up to 300 (skill 200, level 35). 300 is the cap.

facts.label: Favor recipes
facts.value: Necklace enchants need Enchanting 210, Friendly and 120 Merchant's Favor. The two-hand caster enchants need 300, Honored and 240 Favor. Favor comes from sealed Waylaid Crates handed in at Three Corners, Redridge.

facts.label: Legacy
facts.value: The first time you reach 150, 225 and 300 in a craft you earn 1 Legacy point each. Dedicated Study gives a daily skill-up, or Elemental Essences once all your skills are 300.

facts.label: Necklace enchants
facts.value: New necklace enchants add Agility, Deflection, Healing Power, Spell Power or Strength.

facts.label: Two-hand caster enchants
facts.value: Mighty Spell Power, Mighty Healing Power and Spellblasting are new enchants for two-hand weapons.

facts.label: Enchanted Lute
facts.value: The Lute's buff matches Mark of the Wild and does not stack with it, so it only helps when no Druid buff is up.

facts.label: Not known yet
facts.note: Where the Arcane Forge blueprint drops, and which boss really drops the Arcane Salvager blueprint.

facts.label: Not known yet
facts.note: Whether enchants can be sold on the Auction House; a 23 Oct player post says there are still no scrolls or vellums.

facts.label: Not known yet
facts.note: Whether the caster oil changes seen in beta data are in the live game.

facts.label: Not known yet
facts.note: Final Favor prices and reputation gates for the new enchants.

facts.label: Professions window
facts.value: Professions have their own window, opened with K. Recipe lists can be searched and filtered, and you can track a recipe in the objectives frame.

facts.label: Camp buffs
facts.value: Profession camp objects give weaker copies of class buffs that do not stack with the real ones. You sit at the camp for at least 1 minute to get them.

facts.label: Campsite size
facts.value: A basic campsite holds 3 camp features, one per player. Cooking upgrades raise this to 5 or 10.

facts.label: Earning Merchant's Favor
facts.value: Fill Waylaid Crates (found in the world or bought on the Auction House) and hand the sealed crates to Marcy Baker of the Azeroth Commerce Authority at Three Corners in western Redridge. Craftsman's Writs add reputation.

facts.label: Profession title
facts.value: Crafters who reach 300 can earn a certification item that unlocks a profession title. Alliance players get it from the Azeroth Commerce Authority.

facts.label: Vendor prices
facts.value: Blizzard's beta notes say many profession-made items sell to vendors for less.
